plan.hypothesis: On the unchanged controller.gvs_nmpc@7.0.0 stack with control/recipe/terminal_tip_speed_weight frozen at 0.05, setting control/recipe/holding_tip_speed_weight to 0.05 (a joint-positive point that has never been executed; joint_positive_weight_tested false) will lower the sampled final-window holding maximum world-tip speed holding_max_speed_m_s below the 0.03557 m/s measured for source execution 50618bf23b31464ba4f84c55cd26d1ca, toward the 0.02 m/s criterion, while holding_max_error_m <= 0.01 and terminal_error_m <= 0.01 are retained (joint_reach_holding_passed true).
plan.rationale: Source selection: from study_packet.history.rows I select batch-43a6daab7e3c1ce6-3 / execution 50618bf23b31464ba4f84c55cd26d1ca (holding 0.0 / terminal 0.05) as the verified source, because its frozen terminal value 0.05 is exactly the intended fixed condition for this point; it is distinct from the retained baseline (baseline-replay / cf997605) and the latest tested (batch-bc1f58ac54026d97-0 / 44dbf3bc, terminal 0.1). Only the holding speed-weight path is varied, inside the current builder grant; terminal_tip_speed_weight is a fixed numerical setting under other_numerical_settings, not a varied path. Predecessor_decision is copied from study_packet.predecessor_decision. Observations from the six completed configurations: terminal-only positives (50618bf2, 44dbf3bc) retain holding position and terminal reach but never reach holding speed <= 0.02 (0.03557, 0.04868), and the terminal step 0.05 -> 0.1 was an adverse non-monotone increase at that tested point; holding-only positives with terminal 0 (087adee8 at 0.05, 2224110 at 0.1, 25e26708 at 0.3) kept holding position failing (holding_max_error_m 0.0565-0.0634) and 0.1/0.3 additionally lost official_reach_task_success. The joint-positive branch (both weights positive) is untested. Hypothesis (proposed test, not a conclusion): with terminal fixed at 0.05, holding 0.05 lowers holding_max_speed_m_s below 0.03557 while holding_max_error_m and terminal_error_m stay <= 0.01. Scope: this is one previously unevaluated point and cannot establish a dominant cause, monotonicity, or ineffectiveness across a parameter range; a small unsuccessful batch would only describe the tested candidate. All undeclared structural fields (robot), task, acceptance, controller implementation, timing, initializer, solver and horizon are preserved. This is one shared cumulative campaign with no reset or extra grant.
stopping_conditions: Stop after the single planned backend attempt (max_backend_attempts=1) reaching target_changed_configurations=1 distinct changed configuration.
Stop on any unknown or material failure (backend rejection, solver error, invalid or incomplete execution).
If joint_reach_holding_passed is true, stop and consider adoption; if false, stop and report the observed step without separate numerical diagnostic work.
If holding_max_speed_m_s does not fall below 0.03557 m/s, stop and report the observed adverse or non-monotone step rather than extending the batch.
weakening_observations: holding_max_speed_m_s at or above the source value 0.03557 m/s, or an increase like the adverse terminal-weight step (0.05 -> 0.1 raised it from 0.03557 to 0.04868), indicating no sampled reduction at this single tested point.
Loss of holding_max_error_m <= 0.01 or terminal_error_m <= 0.01 (joint_reach_holding_passed false), as seen for the terminal-0 holding-only positives where holding_max_error_m was 0.0565-0.0634.
Any force_bound_violation_n > 0, solver_error_count > 0, or non-valid/incomplete execution.

One previously unevaluated point cannot establish monotonicity, a dominant cause, or ineffectiveness across the weight range; zero force_bound_violation_n in prior rows does not exclude a legal near-bound input.
